set.propagation.title: Propagation check
set.propagation.intro: Compares this zone's SOA serial across all panel servers, the authoritative name servers and public resolvers.
set.propagation.compareContent: Compare zone content between panel servers
set.propagation.compareContentHint: Loads the full zone from every panel server – slower for large zones.
set.propagation.summaryInSync: All {{total}} sources are up to date.
set.propagation.summaryPartial: {{ok}} of {{total}} sources up to date, {{mismatch}} differ, {{failed}} failed.
set.propagation.timedOut: The overall limit of 8 seconds was reached – unanswered queries are marked as timed out.
set.propagation.externalDisabled: External DNS queries are disabled – only the panel servers are compared via the PowerDNS API.
set.propagation.noNameservers: The zone has no NS records at the apex – authoritative check skipped.
set.propagation.singleServer: Only one panel server is configured – no server comparison possible.
set.propagation.separateBackendsInfo: The zone lives on several writable panel servers with separate databases: different serials are normal there, the zone content is compared instead.
set.propagation.whySeparateBackends: Panel servers with separate databases increase their serials independently – different serials are normal then. What matters is the content ("Compare zone content").
set.propagation.whySharedBackend: Servers sharing one database always show the same serial.
set.propagation.whySoaEdit: The serial shown is the one served (after SOA-EDIT); it may differ from the stored serial.
set.propagation.whySecondaries: Secondaries pick up changes only after NOTIFY and a zone transfer (AXFR/IXFR).
set.propagation.whyResolverCache: Public resolvers serve their cached answer until the TTL expires.
set.propagation.whyIpv6: IPv6 targets are only queried when IPv6 is enabled in the settings (Docker networks often lack IPv6).
set.propagation.note_separate_backend: Separate database – the content is compared, not the serial.
set.propagation.note_content_same_serial_dif: Content identical, only the serial differs.
set.propagation.note_resolver_cache: Resolver cache: up to {{ttl}} s left
set.propagation.note_secondary_lagging: Secondary has not picked up the new serial yet.
set.propagation.note_lua_not_comparable: LUA/ALIAS record – the answer is computed dynamically, no comparison.
set.propagation.note_truncated_targets: Only the first 12 name server addresses are queried.
set.propagation.note_ns_from_glue: Address taken from the zone data
set.propagation.err_zone_missing: Zone not present on this server
set.propagation.err_not_loaded: Server not loaded (API key missing or unreadable)
set.propagation.err_refused: Query refused (REFUSED) – server is not responsible for the zone
set.propagation.err_not_authoritative: Answer not authoritative – possibly a lame delegation
set.propagation.err_ns_unresolvable: Name server name cannot be resolved
set.settings.monitoring.loadFailed: Monitoring settings could not be loaded.
set.settings.monitoring.statusSubtitle: Background tasks, database migrations, PowerDNS servers and encryption
set.settings.monitoring.statusBackgroundDisa: Background tasks are switched off by configuration (BACKGROUND_WORKERS_ENABLED).
set.settings.monitoring.statusMigrationError: Failed database migrations at the last start: {{n}} – see the container log for details.
set.settings.monitoring.secretsModePlaintext: Secrets are NOT encrypted (plaintext fallback) – check the key
set.settings.monitoring.propSubtitle: External DNS queries for the propagation check in the zone view
set.settings.monitoring.propEnabledHint: The backend then sends SOA and record queries (UDP/TCP 53) to the zone's name servers and to the resolvers below. Without this option only the panel servers are compared via the PowerDNS API.
set.settings.monitoring.propAuthoritative: Query the zone's authoritative name servers
set.settings.monitoring.propIpv6Hint: Only enable this if the backend container has IPv6 connectivity.
set.settings.monitoring.propResolvers: Public resolvers (one IP address per line)
set.settings.monitoring.propResolversHint: At most 10 entries, IPv4/IPv6 addresses only, port 53. Empty = do not query resolvers.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsEnvOverride: Controlled by the METRICS_TOKEN environment variable – settings here are locked.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsTokenUnreadab: The stored token cannot be read (key changed?) – please create a new token.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsTokenRotateCo: Create a new token? The current token stops working immediately – update your Prometheus configuration.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsTokenDeleteCo: Delete the token? The /metrics endpoint will be disabled.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsTokenModalWar: This token is shown only now. Store it in your Prometheus configuration (e.g. as a credentials_file with mode 600).
set.settings.monitoring.metricsTokenCopyFail: Copy failed – please select it manually.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsPdnsProbe: Probe PowerDNS servers on scrape (reachability, zone count; cached)
set.settings.monitoring.metricsScrapeHint: Example for prometheus.yml – store the token in a file with mode 600.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsNoBaseUrl: No public base URL set – enter it under Profile and the full address appears here.
set.settings.monitoring.metricsGrafanaHint: Add Prometheus as a data source. Useful queries:
set.settings.monitoring.metricsSecurityHint: Do not expose /metrics to the internet: allow only your Prometheus server in the reverse proxy.
